findings.authorizedBy: Compression, and catalog 4.1 read onto the honest answer is.
findings.diagnosis: The phrase is the section's spine. It appears twice by design and marks the two places where the writer stops describing a problem and concedes ignorance in his own voice, which is what the section's opening promises. Removing it leaves two statements of fact about the state of the art, which any survey could make, and removes the admission. The section exists to admit, not to survey.

findings.summary: The opening lost the causal link between the requirement and the temptation it guards against.

evidence.baseline: requires naming honestly what has not been figured out, because the temptation in this kind of writing is to gesture at solutions and let the reader's imagination complete them. That move is exactly what produces the failures the next decade will be working to clean up.
evidence.shipped: requires an honest account of what has not been figured out. Writing of this kind can gesture at solutions and let the reader's imagination complete them. That move produces the failures the next decade will be working to clean up.

findings.diagnosis: Because names why the naming is required, which is the paragraph's argument. Split off, the temptation becomes an observation about a genre rather than the reason this section exists. The temptation is also something a writer feels, and Writing of this kind can gesture relocates it to the writing, removing the agent. Exactly what produces likewise identifies this move as the cause of the failures, where produces states a tendency.

findings.summary: The surveillance problem's key qualification was promoted out of its sentence, losing the contrast it carried.

evidence.baseline: creates infrastructure that future actors, not the founders, but those who acquire, modify, or coerce the system later, could repurpose
evidence.shipped: creates infrastructure future actors could repurpose. Those actors may not be the founders. They may be people who later acquire, modify, or coerce the system.

findings.authorizedBy: R-PUNCT-STRUCT, applied by splitting rather than rebuilding.
findings.diagnosis: The interruption is a correction the sentence makes to itself while still in motion: future actors, and then immediately, not the ones you are picturing. Promoted to two sentences with may not be, the correction becomes a hedged possibility rather than a definition of who the threat is. The whole point of the second problem is that the threat model is not the founders, so weakening that to may not be undercuts the problem being named.

findings.summary: Five parallel in phrases and a two-part predicate were compressed in the third problem.

evidence.baseline: vary enormously in baseline autonomic regulation, in response to stress, in interoceptive capacity, in neurodivergence, in the physiological signatures of legitimate cultural and individual difference ... would reward the narrow band ... and would systematically disadvantage anyone whose body operates differently
evidence.shipped: vary enormously in baseline autonomic regulation, response to stress, interoceptive capacity, neurodivergence, and the physiological signatures of legitimate cultural and individual difference ... would reward the narrow band ... It would systematically disadvantage anyone whose body operates differently

findings.diagnosis: Repeating in makes five independent dimensions of variation rather than one list of related traits, which matters because the problem is that the dimensions are not commensurable. The paired would reward and would systematically disadvantage are also one sentence naming a single design failure with two faces; split, the disadvantage becomes a second consequence and the symmetry that made it a single fault is gone.

regenerationTest.purpose: The rules must reproduce the section from the baseline without consulting the stored text.
regenerationTest.method: Derived from the immutable baseline applying editorial/method/standard.md, the corpus voice card, the volume-02 voice card, and the debt ledger under R-LEDGER-WINS.
regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. F1 is the section's defining loss and it is a voice loss rather than an argument loss: every fact survives, and the person admitting them does not. The honest answer is that is the narrator taking responsibility for an admission, and a compression pass will read it as filler every time, because in isolation it adds no information. What it adds is an author.
